title: GenLogic Schema
description: GenLogic YAML schema for Augmented Normalization - Foreign keys are DATA PIPELINES that create columns AND automation pathways

columns.description: Reusable column definitions that can be inherited and overridden in table definitions. Reusable columns can also inherit from other reusable columns using $ref.

tables.description: Table definitions with foreign keys as named data pipelines

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.title: Valid PostgreSQL table name
^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: Must start with letter or underscore, followed by letters, numbers, or underscores

matching_tables.description: Pattern matching tables with fixed structure (id, string_match, result, range_low_bound, range_high_bound)

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.title: Valid PostgreSQL table name
^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: Matching table with automatic structure and stored procedures

reusableColumnDefinition.description: Reusable column definition - can be a full definition or can inherit from another reusable column

oneOf.description: Inherit from another reusable column with optional overrides

$ref.description: Name of reusable column to inherit from

ui-notes.description: Override or add UI guidance notes

columnDefinition.description: Column definition with type, constraints, and optional automation

type.description: PostgreSQL column type (e.g., integer, varchar, numeric)

size.description: Size parameter for types that support it (e.g., varchar size)

decimal.description: Decimal places for numeric types (only valid when size is present)

primary_key.description: Whether this column is part of the primary key

unique.description: Whether this column has a unique constraint

not_null.description: Whether this column has a NOT NULL constraint

sequence.description: Whether to create a sequence for this column (auto-increment)

automation.description: GENLOGIC CORE: Automation that references FK names, not table names

calculated.description: SQL expression for calculated column (e.g., 'column1 + column2'). Mutually exclusive with automation.

ui-notes.description: UI guidance notes for this column

items.description: UI behavior hints: read-only (not editable), hidden (don't show in UI)

tableColumnDefinition.description: Table column with mixed inheritance: empty object (inherit same name), string (inherit named), object with $ref (inherit + override)

oneOf.description: Null/empty value - inherit from reusable column of same name
String value - inherit from named reusable column (for renaming)
Object with $ref - inherit from reusable column and override properties

$ref.description: Name of reusable column to inherit from - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in top-level 'columns' section

ui-notes.description: Override or add UI guidance notes

tableDefinition.description: Table definition with foreign keys as named data pipelines

ui-notes.description: UI guidance notes - not processed by database, expanded in resolved schema

items.description: UI behavior hints: singleton (expect 1 row), no-insert/update/delete (disable CRUD operations)

columns.description: Column definitions - can inherit from reusable columns or define inline

foreign_keys.description: GENLOGIC CORE: Named data pipelines that create columns AND automation pathways

content.description: Seed data rows to insert if not already present (checked by primary key)

items.description: Row data as key-value pairs matching column names. Values can be literals or $lookup objects for foreign key resolution.

foreignKeyDefinition.description: GENLOGIC: Foreign key as named data pipeline - creates columns and defines automation paths

table.description: Target table name - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in 'tables' section

auto_create.description: GENLOGIC: Auto-create rows in this table when parent table changes (sync/spread pattern)

autoCreateDefinition.description: FK-following auto-creation: sync (1:1 row copy) or spread (1:N date range expansion)

spread.description: Generate multiple rows from date range and interval (omit for simple sync)

start.description: Column name in parent table containing start date

end.description: Column name in parent table containing end date

interval.description: Column name in parent table containing PostgreSQL interval value

generated_column.description: Column name in this (child) table to populate with generated dates

copy_columns.description: Map parent columns to child columns (parent_col: child_col)

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: Parent column name mapped to child column name

literals.description: Constant values to set in child table

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: Child column name and literal SQL value to set

filter.description: Optional SQL WHERE condition to filter which parent rows trigger creation

automationDefinition.description: GENLOGIC PRINCIPLE: Automations specify explicit data flow pathways

oneOf.description: Standard automation (SUM, COUNT, MAX, etc.) using foreign keys

table.description: Source table name for the automation - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in 'tables' section

foreign_key.description: GENLOGIC CORE: FK name within the source table - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in specified table's foreign_keys section

column.description: Source column name for the automation

oneOf.description: RULE_MATCH automation using dynamic pattern matching (generates stored procedures)

mode.description: Automation mode - generates stored procedures for middleware control

source_table.description: Table containing the matching rules - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in 'tables' section

source_columns.description: Column names in source table that define the matching rules

match_column.description: Column in source specifying which destination column to match

operator.description: Column in source specifying comparison operator

compare_value.description: Column in source with the pattern to match

target_value.description: Column in source with value to set in destination

priority.description: Column in source for tie-breaking when multiple rules match

destination_columns.description: List of columns in destination table that can be matched against - VALIDATION REQUIRED: Must exist in destination table

overwrite_policy.description: Policy for overwriting existing values in destination column

matchingTableDefinition.description: Pattern matching table with fixed structure and automatic stored procedures
